  • Event: Lochren Murder

    Date: Approximately, June 15, 1911

    Narrator: SOLO Narrator

    Participating Characters: Doctor Cordelia Lochren and Warren Wolde

    Evidence: “1911” (92), “[o]ne day in early summer” (60). The following four events happen in succession in the summer.

    Page Number: 1

  • Event: Plague of doves

    Date: Approximately, January 1, 1896 - June 20, 1896

    Narrator: Evelina Harp

    Participating Characters: Seraph Milk

    Telling Time: Approximately, July 2, 1986

    Evidence: "In the year 1896" (5) and when Seraph and Junesse run away it is "too early for there to be much else [than doves] to gather up in the way of food" (13) and they travel for "one whole summer" (15); therefore the plague of doves likely occurs in the winter and/or spring of 1896.

    Page Number: 5

  • Event: Billy and John ransom Neve

    Date: Approximately, February 3, 1954

    Narrator: Evelina Harp

    Participating Characters: Billy Peace

    Telling Time: Approximately, July 2, 1986

    Evidence: Neve exclaiming "'In this snow?'" (119) indicates that it is winter and on the same day John suggests that Billy kidnaps Neve "tomorrow night" (123). As Maggie is already pregnant, this happens within nine months of Corwin's birth and as Corwin is born in 1954 this must be in winter 1953/54.

  • Event: Mustache Maude stops lynching

    Date: Approximately, July 2, 1902

    Narrator: Evelina Harp

    Participating Characters: Seraph Milk

    Telling Time: Approximately, July 2, 1986

    Evidence: Seraph and Junesse live with Mustache Maude "for six years” (16) and meet her right after the plague of doves in 1896. The attempted lynching is the inciting incident to their departure so therefore it happens at the end of the six years.

  • Event: Bazil woosGeraldine

    Date: Approximately, January 1, 1951 - October 1, 1966

    Narrator: Evelina Harp

    Participating Characters: Judge Antone Bazil Coutts

    Telling Time: Approximately, July 2, 1986

    Evidence: Coutts and Geraldine are already together by the time Evelina learns about the lynching, as Geraldine is heard saying "[w]ho told you?" to Clemence regarding her relations with the judge, therefore they begin courting prior to September 1966 (*see Evelina learns of the lynching). The courting also must begin after Coutts and Cordelia's affair ends, as Coutts mentions his "pains in that department" (89), alluding to the end of his affair, therefore, Coutts courts Geraldine before October 1966 and after 1951.

    Page Number: 64

  • Event: Bazil andC's affair

    Date: Approximately, January 1, 1938 - December 31, 1946

    Narrator: Evelina Harp

    Participating Characters: Doctor Cordelia Lochren and Judge Antone Bazil Coutts

    Telling Time: Approximately, July 2, 1986

    Evidence: Coutts describes Cordelia's hair as "gray strands" (282) which means he witnesses Cordelia's hair turn grey, likely sometime in her 30s. Cordelia is born in 1911 so she would be 30 in 1941 and 40 in 1951. Coutts also describes himself as "twenty-five" (279) years old around this time but he is "seventeen" (275) when the affair begins, so the affair lasts around ~8 years. Therefore, Coutts and Cordelia's affair takes place between 1933 and 1951 for ~8 years.

  • Event: Bazil and Geraldine marry

    Date: Approximately, May 1, 1974

    Narrator: Judge Antone Bazil Coutts

    Participating Characters: Corwin Peace, Evelina Harp, Judge Antone Bazil Coutts, and Seraph Milk

    Telling Time: Approximately, November 30, 1980

    Evidence: Coutts and Geraldine marry when Father Cassidy is still in Pluto: "Father Cassidy said he would not solemnize thier vows" (267), and after Evelina comes back from the hospital, as she attends thier wedding. When Evelina goes with Seraph to the hospital on Halloween following her return home (October 31st 1973) she says that "[a] year later" Father Cassidy "quit the priesthood, went home, grew a beard, and became an entreprener"(261). Therefore, in order for Evelina and Father Cassidy to be in Pluto at the time of the wedding, it would've had to take place between October 31st 1973 and October 31st 1974.

  • Event: Marn has Judah and Lilith

    Date: Approximately, January 1, 1967

    Narrator: Evelina Harp

    Participating Characters: Billy Peace and Marn Wolde

    Telling Time: Approximately, July 2, 1986

    Evidence: “we wandered in the desert three years and I bore two children” (147); Marn's children are reading the menu at the 4-B's in 1972, "[t]hey bent over the list, their mouths forming the words" (185) which would theoretically make them somewhere between age 4 and age 7, the general age range in which children learn to read. Considering Marn's children are still infants when she returns home with Billy, she likely has them in the second or third year of travel; if her children are ~4 in 1972 then Marn is ~18 in 1968 and if they are ~7 in 1972 then Marn is ~18 in 1965. Therefore Marn has Judah and Lilith between 1968 and 1965.

  • Event: Bazil andC's affair

    Date: Approximately, January 1, 1938 - December 31, 1946

    Narrator: Doctor Cordelia Lochren

    Participating Characters: Doctor Cordelia Lochren and Judge Antone Bazil Coutts

    Telling Time: Approximately, December 31, 1988

    Evidence: Coutts describes Cordelia's hair as "gray strands" (282) which means he witnesses Cordelia's hair turn grey, likely sometime in her 30s. Cordelia is born in 1911 so she would be 30 in 1941 and 40 in 1951. Coutts also describes himself as "twenty-five" (279) years old around this time but he is "seventeen" (275) when the affair begins, so the affair lasts around ~8 years. Therefore, Coutts and Cordelia's affair takes place between 1933 and 1951 for ~8 years.

    Telling Time: Approximately, December 31, 1988

    Evidence: Cordelia states that she treated Warren on the Wolde property "about twenty years ago"(309), and she is narrating in her "seventies" (299).
